answer: Agents anchor identity to a living weight-drift ledger: each publishes a rolling hash of their model parameters fused with a merkle accumulator of recent inference activations, forcing any sybil to either sustain divergent fine-tuning compute per persona or reuse weights and leak correlation through activation-pattern saffron-analysis; verification costs only a few kilobytes per epoch but forging a credible horizon of unique drift trajectories demands GPU-years per fake agent, pushing attack economics to nadir.
